## Root

```typescript
Root: Element | null;
```

The UI root element, or `None` when not in game / not yet resolved.

## Hover

```typescript
Hover: Element | null;
```

The element under the cursor (primary hover slot), or `None`. C# `Poe2UiAccessor.Hover`.

## HoverElement

```typescript
HoverElement: Element | null;
```

The game's secondary hover slot (+0x658; some elements register here, not in `Hover`), debounced
and viewport-noise-filtered, or `None`. C# `Poe2UiAccessor.HoverElement`. LIVE-VERIFY the offset.

## Stash

```typescript
Stash: Element | null;
```

The stash panel element, or `None` when the stash is closed. C# `Poe2UiAccessor.Stash` (typed
stash data — tabs, visible index — is on `World.Stash`).

## Inventory

```typescript
Inventory: Element | null;
```

The inventory panel element, or `None` when the inventory is closed. C# `Poe2UiAccessor.Inventory`
(typed backpack data is on `World.Inventory`).

## Party

```typescript
Party: Element | null;
```

The party panel element, or `None` when unavailable. C# `Poe2UiAccessor.Party` (typed member
rows are on `World.Party`).

## Invites

```typescript
Invites: Element | null;
```

The invites panel element, or `None` when unavailable. C# `Poe2UiAccessor.Invites`.

## Social

```typescript
Social: Element | null;
```

The social panel element, or `None` when unavailable. C# `Poe2UiAccessor.SocialPanel`.

## Map

```typescript
Map: Element | null;
```

The in-game map/minimap root element, or `None` when unavailable. C# `Poe2UiAccessor.Map`.

## GroundLabels

```typescript
GroundLabels: Element | null;
```

The ground-item label root element, or `None` when labels are unavailable. C#
`Poe2UiAccessor.GroundLabels`.

## SocialPartyTab

```typescript
SocialPartyTab: Element | null;
```

Party tab inside the social panel, resolved EC2-style by fixed child indices. Returns `None`
while the social panel child tree is not populated.

## EnumWindows

```typescript
EnumWindows(predicate?: (element: Element) => boolean): Element[];
```

Enumerate currently open gameplay windows. Elements are valid for the current tick only.
The optional predicate runs synchronously once per window; unreadable UI throws.

**@keywords**

windows, panels, enumerate, filter, inspect

## CloseAllWindows

```typescript
CloseAllWindows(): Promise<void>;
```

Close all detected gameplay windows using the configured close_panels hotkey and await confirmation.
Rejects if the hotkey is unbound, UI is unavailable, the operation is interrupted, or closure times out.
Sends no input when no windows are open, but still requires a configured hotkey.

**@keywords**

windows, panels, close, cleanup, hotkey, await
